basic_details.short_information: The Institute of Liver and Biliary Sciences (ILBS), Delhi, has 3 posts of Consultant Grade IV: one each in Radiology, Clinical Genetics and Nuclear Medicine. All 3 posts are for the UR (unreserved) category and are on contract for one year. Candidates send the filled application form with their certificates by email to [email protected]. The last date is 28 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: About ILBS
content_sections.text: The notice describes the Institute of Liver and Biliary Sciences (ILBS) as an autonomous super-specialty institute under GNCT of Delhi and a Deemed-to-be-University by the UGC. ILBS works in patient care, teaching and research on liver, gall bladder and pancreatobiliary diseases. The notice gives the institute's address as D – 1, Vasant Kunj, Delhi – 110070.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Email the filled application form to [email protected] by 28 October 2026. Attach your supporting education and experience certificates. The notice gives these steps: Download the faculty application form from the ILBS website (https://www.ilbs.in/images/media/faculty-form.pdf). Check your eligibility for the post in the Recruitment Rules and category uploaded on the ILBS website (Recruitment Rules page in Career Opportunities). Pay the application fee by electronic transfer to the bank account printed in the notice and the form (see the fee section below). Fill in the application form. Email the form with the documents listed under Enclosures to [email protected] by 28 October 2026. For questions, call the ILBS HR department on 011-46300000, Ext. 23234 and 23233. The application form explains how to pay online: by electronic transfer to Account No. 50100143852078, RTGS/NEFT IFSC HDFC0000273, HDFC Bank, Site No. 2, OCF Pocket, Sector - C, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi - 110070 branch. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ILBS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1-UR each for Consultant (Radiology) Grade IV, Consultant (Clinical Genetics) Grade IV and Consultant (Nuclear Medicine) Grade IV.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ILBS Consultant Grade IV posts?
faq.answer: The filled application form must be emailed to [email protected] by 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the ILBS Consultant Grade IV posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is 50 years for each post. The upper limit is relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 5 years for persons with disabilities (10 years for SC/ST and 8 years for OBC candidates with disabilities).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for ILBS Consultant Grade IV?
faq.answer: The pay is PB - IV, GP - 8700 (pre-revised), with the 7th CPC applicable at the pay level that applies at ILBS.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for ILBS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 590/- (Rs. 500/- + 18% GST), or Rs. 118/- for SC/ST, EWS and Ex-Serviceman candidates. Persons with disabilities pay no fee, and the fee cannot be refunded.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the ILBS Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Download the faculty form from the ILBS website, pay the fee by electronic transfer, and email the filled form with your certificates to [email protected] by 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the ILBS Consultant Grade IV posts?
faq.answer: A Screening Committee checks the applications against the Recruitment Rules, and shortlisted candidates are called for an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Are the ILBS Consultant Grade IV posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are on a contract basis for one year, and either side can end the contract with at least three months' written notice or salary instead of notice.

faq.question: Q9. Is computer knowledge required for the ILBS Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Yes. A working knowledge of computers is essential for all the posts.
